prompt: Create a romantic cinematic outdoor portrait at sunset. A young man with thick dark tousled hair and a short beard sits on an old weathered stone bench in a garden or historic terrace, looking up thoughtfully toward the right. He wears a cream, camel-brown, and navy color-blocked knit sweater with the visible handwritten text I can't live without you, plus exactly 2 small graphics on the chest: one red heart and one red rose stem. He holds a pencil in one hand and an open sketchbook in the other, showing a realistic pencil portrait of a beautiful young woman with long wavy hair and earrings. In the sky above and behind him, create a large dreamy semi-transparent face of the same woman, softly blended into glowing orange clouds as if she is a memory or vision; she has long dark wavy hair, delicate makeup, dangling floral earrings, and a sparkling necklace, with a gentle smile. The background includes exactly 1 vintage black streetlamp glowing warmly on the upper left, rose bushes with red flowers, old stone architecture on the right, and a low sun near the horizon. Use golden-hour lighting, warm amber and orange tones, romantic atmosphere, shallow depth of field, realistic photography style with subtle fantasy compositing, high detail, soft haze, natural skin texture, 3:4 vertical composition. No extra people, no watermark, no distorted hands, keep the sketchbook portrait clearly visible.

promptZh: 创作一幅浪漫的电影质感户外日落肖像。一位留着浓密凌乱深色头发和短胡须的年轻男子，坐在花园或历史悠久的露台上的一张陈旧风化的石凳上，若有所思地向右上方仰望。他穿着一件奶油色、驼棕色和海军蓝拼色的针织毛衣，毛衣上清晰可见手写文字 I can't live without you，胸前还有 2 个小图案：一颗红心和一朵红玫瑰花茎。他一手拿着铅笔，另一手拿着一本打开的素描本，本子上展示着一幅逼真的铅笔素描肖像，画中是一位留着长波浪卷发、戴着耳环的年轻美女。在他身后的天空中，创作一张该女子巨大的、梦幻般的半透明面庞，柔和地融入发光的橙色云层中，仿佛她是记忆或幻象；她留着深色长波浪卷发，妆容精致，戴着垂坠花朵耳环和闪亮的项链，面带温柔的微笑。背景包括左上方一盏散发着温暖光芒的复古黑色路灯、开着红花的玫瑰丛、右侧古老的石质建筑以及地平线附近的低垂落日。采用黄金时刻的光影，暖琥珀色和橙色调，浪漫氛围，浅景深，写实摄影风格并结合微妙的奇幻合成，高细节，柔和雾气，自然的皮肤纹理，3:4 竖构图。画面中没有其他人，没有水印，没有扭曲的手部，确保素描本上的肖像清晰可见。
